title: Chart
description: Render bar, line, area, pie or doughnut charts from data.
author: Harald Bregu

data.description: Rows of data. Each row has the xKey field and one number per series key.

xKey.description: Field used for the x-axis categories, or the slice names for pie and doughnut.

series.description: Numeric fields to plot. Pie and doughnut use only the first series.
